title: Yatiñan Arupa
intro: Mä llamp’u yatiñan arupax nayrax pachat sipan juk’amp iwxt’awinak uñt’ayawayi. Aka jakhüwix wali amuyt’asiñamp bendicita, wali aski yatichäwinak pasawayi, ukax mä qhanjamaw qhiparaski taqi khitinakatix irpañ munapki ukanakataki. ¿Uka wiñay arunak qhipäxan khitis uk amuytʼasmati?
clues: Allah-an mä jach’a bendicionap katuqawayta, mä regalo ukaw chuymajar ukhamarak amuyunakajar qhant’ayitu.
Munat wawajaruw kuttʼayäta, kunatï utjkitu ukat sipansa jukʼamp valoranïki ukanak yatiyañ munasaw ukham lurayäta.
Mä sapa cheqpach Diosamp chiktʼatäñaw jukʼamp jachʼa jan cheqapar uñjañajja sasaw ewjjtʼayäta.
Mä mostaza jatha pesaje ukhas, mä qala manqhan jan ukax alaxpachat juk’ampi imantat, Allah-an cuenta churani sasaw amtayäta.
Nayajj awk taykanakar sum phoqañatakiw ewjjtʼta, istʼasirïñajj cheqapar sarnaqañ toqet parlkchisa.
Nayax sapuru sarnaqawinak yatichawayta: aka uraqinx alt’at chuymampiw sarnaqañama ukat arumax mä juk’a arumpiw sarnaqañama; kunattix jukʼamp qhuru arunakxa asnonakan arnaqasitapawa.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
